description: Source code for managing passphrases, including setting, changing, and generating password entries, with functions for file handling, password verification, and SRP (Secure Remote Password) protocol operations.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the program; parses command-line arguments and initiates passphrase setting process.

methods.name: doit
methods.description: Handles the process of setting a passphrase for a user, including verification and updating the password file.

methods.name: t_changepw
methods.description: Changes the password in the specified password file, creating backups and handling file renaming.

methods.name: t_makepwent
methods.description: Creates a new password entry with SRP parameters based on user credentials and configuration.

methods.name: t_pwcopy
methods.description: Copies password entries from one file to another, optionally replacing a specific entry.

methods.name: t_getpwent
methods.description: Retrieves the next password entry from the input stream, supporting NIS integration.

methods.name: t_putpwent
methods.description: Writes a password entry to a file in base64-encoded format.
